div.head: II Cn 82
div.ab: ⁊ ic wylle, þæt ælc man si griðes wyrðe to gemote ⁊ fram gemote, butan he si æbǽre þeof.
And ic wille, þæt ælc man beo griðes wyrðe to gemote ⁊ fram gemote, buton he æbere ðeof beo.
⁊ ic wille, þæt ælc man sy griðes wyrðe to gemote ⁊ fram gemote, buton he æbære þeof sy.
Et uolo, ut omnis homo pacem habeat eundo ad gemotum uel rediens de gemoto (id est placito), nisi probatus fur sit.
Pręcipimus etiam, ut omnis homo habeat pacem et securitatem eundo et redeundo ad placitum, nisi sit latro publicus omnino.
[82] (De pace domini regis et eius preceptis.) Precipio quoque, ut omnis homo pacem habeat placitum adeundo et a placito redeundo, nisi sit manifestus fur.
And ic wille þæt ælc man beo griðes wyrðe to gemote ⁊ fram gemote, buton he æbere ðeof beo.
And ic wylle þæt ælc man si griðes wyrðe to gemote and fram gemote, butan he si æbære þeof.
Und ich will, dass jedermann besonderen Friedensschutzes theilhaftig sei [auf dem Wege] zum Gericht und vom Gericht, wenn er nicht ein unleugbarer Dieb ist.
And I will that every man be entitled to special peace-protection [on the way] to the court and from the court, unless he is an undeniable thief.
And it is my will that every man shall be entitled to protection in going to and from assemblies, unless he be a notorious thief.
And it is my will that every man is to be entitled to peace, going to a meeting and from a meeting, unless he is a manifest thief.
And it is my will that everyone shall be entitled to protection on the way to and from assemblies unless he is a known thief.
